title: Koszul orthogonality propagates to positive powers
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r≥0, f:Fin(r)→A and X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], with a chosen derived category D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. For a tuple g, let K(g) be the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], extended to cochain degrees −q, sheafified termwise and localized. Let E be any object of D(O_X). If Hom(K(f)[n],E)=0 for all n∈ℤ, then for every e:Fin(r)→ℕ with e_i>0 and every n∈ℤ one has Hom(K((f_i^{e_i})_i)[n],E)=0. No quasi-coherence assumption on E is needed.

source.place: Tag 09IR, lemma-orthogonal-koszul-complex, Koszul multiplication triangles; More on Algebra, Tag 062C, lemma-koszul-mult

proof.text: Write K(g) for the extended, termwise sheafified and localized Koszul complex. Strongly induct on the sum of the positive exponents. If every exponent equals one then the powered tuple is f, so the hypothesis horth applies. Otherwise choose i with e(i)>1.

The tuples update(e,i,e(i)-1) and update(e,i,1) are positive and have strictly smaller exponent sums, by Finset.sum_lt_sum. Apply the induction hypothesis at the required arbitrary integer shift to both tuples. The coordinate multiplication triangle with a=f(i)^(e(i)-1), b=f(i) has these as its outer objects, and its middle tuple is the desired tuple by pow_succ and Function.update_eq_self.

Shift the distinguished triangle by n using Pretriangulated.Triangle.shift_distinguished. For each map from the middle object to E its restriction along the first arrow is zero by the first induction hypothesis. Triangle.yoneda_exact₂ factors it through the third object. The second induction hypothesis makes this factor zero, so every map from the middle object to E is zero. This proves Subsingleton without any quasi-coherence assumption. For the empty tuple the all-one base case applies vacuously.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09IR, multiplication triangles and positive-exponent induction. The Lean proof strongly inducts on sum(e_i), equivalent to sum(e_i-1) under positivity.

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_powers_orthogonal_of_orthogonal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (horth : ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r f).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))⟦n⟧ ⟶ E))
    (e : Fin r → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) (n : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton ((DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
            _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
            ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ f i ^ e i)).extend
              ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)))⟦n⟧ ⟶ E)
